meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: Nordic Data by Mnymann
connector.registryDescription: Company, KYB, VAT, sanctions, LEI and address data for 15 EU countries.
connector.summary: Hosted at nordic-data-mcp-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package nordic-data-mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mnymann account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer ndk_... — your personal API key from https://addonnordic.com

env.name: NORDIC_API_KEY
env.description: Your Nordic Data API key — get one at https://addonnordic.com (free tier: 100 lookups/day)

env.name: NORDIC_DEFAULT_COUNTRY
env.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (lowercase) to assume when a tool call omits the country argument. One of: dk, no, se, fi, ie, uk, fr, de, cz, pl, lv, ee, nl, be, lu.

env.name: NORDIC_VERBOSE_ERRORS
env.description: Optional. Set to 'true' to include upstream HTTP status and request-id details in error messages. Useful for debugging.
